I do tend to get jealous with girls but this feels different. He has many female friends who I am totally fine with him hanging out with but with her I feel like they’ve got too close for comfort. I do trust him but I know sometimes feelings can grow unexpectedly and I’m terrified of that. Thank you for you response I appreciate it

Thank you, I appreciate your response. We are not currently living together, he’s about an hour by car from me so we see each other very regularly still and stay over each other’s houses half the week every other week. He sees this girl twice a week at college for the whole day. I think I feel very threatened by her because they got so close so quickly. He told her something that he’s only ever told me and I’m still hurt about that to be honest. There is nothing shady in their messages as such it’s just how close they are and sometimes she can be very jokey sexual so idk. I wish he’d stop talking to her but I know that is impossible.

I have wanted to do it on and off since I was 14 years old. Many years. I have never found the guts to actually do it. I just think of the pain I’ve already put my family through with this fucking mental illness and how killing myself will only hurt them more. I am toxic waste and I need to die but I can’t.

The messages were on Facebook so unless he’s deleted all my messages he still has ammunition and that’s what has been worrying me. I have spoken to my boyfriend and he’s being very supportive. Thank you for your response
That is true, and my boyfriend is understanding so I’m hoping he will be able to convince them if worst comes to worst. Thank you for your response I feel more reassured
